evidence: IDF remains the best weighting: 0.3666 / 0.4302 versus sqrt-IDF 0.3207 / 0.3777, PPMI 0.3451 / 0.3946, and row 0.2468 / 0.2543.
observation: Row-normalised, sqrt-IDF, PPMI and evidence-count variants were added to the same SVD edge-selection protocol. Plain IDF remained best on both macro and micro, so the earlier weighting rule held after the extra variants.
subject: F-67
title: IDF is the best of the tested matrix weightings
